objective: Implement src/render/sprites.js per ARCH.md: loadSprites() loads public/assets/manifest.json then each public/assets/sprites/<name>.png as ImageBitmap/Image in parallel (missing files tolerated). Sprites.has(name), Sprites.size(name), Sprites.draw(ctx,name,dx,dy,{flip?,alpha?,scale?,tint?}) with imageSmoothingEnabled=false; if sprite missing draw a deterministic hashed-color placeholder rect so the game is always playable. Also export `terrainSprite(type,x,y)` mapping terrain type+tile coords to a deterministic variant name (tile_grass_1..3, tile_water_1..2 etc, with names: tile_deep,tile_water,tile_sand,tile_grass,tile_forest,tile_rock,tile_mountain,tile_snow) and `settlerSprite(role,dir,frame)`. Pure, DOM only where needed.
